notes.title: “The Escape Room Chronicles ep1” AVAILABLE NOW!!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=0TZwfhh4TUo;full][/previewyoutube]
The Escape Room Chronicles, [b]over 1.5 million copies[/b] sold, returns refined for Steam!

[b]“The Escape Room Chronicles ep1:The Mysterious KumaDonald's”[/b] is available now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3196770/

[h3]“ep1:The Mysterious KumaDonald's” Introduction[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320773/19737c99fbc50a8f4077e4ddf4cdc7205826aff8.jpg[/img]

It all starts at KumaDonald's, a famous burger chain. After dozing off inside, our protagonist wakes to an empty restaurant—no customers, no staff, and an exit that's locked tight!

The curtain rises on a dramatic escape from a chain restaurant tucked away in a far corner of the world.

Discover items and use your wits to solve puzzles in this mystery! The simple yet profound mysteries offer an irresistible thrill when solved.

notes.title: March 17th, Update Information (version 1.0.5)
notes.content:
We've fixed the following bug.
 -Fixed a bug in stage "Six", where you can carry over items to the second half when finishing the first half with a specific procedure.

notes.title: January 8th Update Information (version 1.0.4)
notes.content:
We've fixed the following bugs.
 -Loop: A bug where the position of the shape on the monitor changes
 -Six: A bug where the files can be stacked
 -Guardian Angel: A bug that makes it impossible to proceed with a specific procedure
 -Eternity: Fixed texts
 -Achievement "Loser's Draw"related bugs

notes.title: December 25th Update Information (1.0.3 version)
notes.content:
We've fixed the following bugs.
 -A bug where the file disappears by specific operation in stage "Six"
 -Partially changed the hint image in stage "Father"

notes.title: December 23rd Update Information (1.0.2 version)
notes.content:
Following bug has been fixed. 
 -The game cannot be started since the game blacks out after the startup movie.
  From this 1.0.2 version, you are able to skip the movie before it runs by clicking the mouse (keyboard: space key, controller: A button) on the logo display screen at startup.
  Please try continuous click if you cannot skip the movie. 

Following bug has been fixed.   
  -A bug that the loading fails at a specific timing.
